name: Dr. Rajesh Alugolu
verified_role: Senior Consultant Neurosurgeon and Clinical Director, PDMDRC (Parkinson's Disease and Movement Disorders Research Centre), Yashoda Hospitals, Hitec City, Hyderabad. Sub-specialises in DBS and stereotactic/functional neurosurgery, skull base and vascular neurosurgery, spinal and cranial neuromodulation, and epilepsy surgery. Formerly Additional/Associate Professor of Neurosurgery at NIMS, Hyderabad and Senior Consultant at Citi Neuro Centre.
verified_experience: 26 years (Yashoda official profile). MS (General Surgery), MCh (Neurosurgery, from NIMS Hyderabad, 2009). Telangana State Medical Council registration TSMC 16825. Reported 5000+ neurosurgical procedures and 850+ DBS procedures.
hni_signals: Clinical Director of a named research centre (PDMDRC - Parkinson's Disease & Movement Disorders Research Centre) at a major corporate hospital - strong leadership signal. 26 years' experience with 5000+ neurosurgical procedures and 850+ DBS procedures reported. Executive member of the Indian Society of Stereotactic & Functional Neurosurgery (ISSFN); life member of the Neuro-Spinal Surgeons' Association of India and the Andhra Pradesh Neuroscientists' Association. Former Additional/Associate Professor of Neurosurgery at NIMS Hyderabad with a substantial academic record (maintains a ResearchGate profile).
